description: Add or remove labels on multiple Gmail messages at once. More efficient than modifying one at a time. Common bulk operations: - Mark all as read: remove_label_ids = ["UNREAD"] - Archive all: remove_label_ids = ["INBOX"] - Star all: add_label_ids = ["STARRED"] The message_ids should come from gmail_search results. Maximum ~1000 messages per batch. This Gmail connection has no untrash, spam or filter tools. Restore a message from Trash with remove_label_ids ["TRASH"] and add_label_ids ["INBOX"]; mark spam with add_label_ids ["SPAM"] and remove_label_ids ["INBOX"] (the reverse for not spam). If Gmail refuses a system label, tell the user plainly that this connection cannot do that and that they can do it in Gmail. It cannot create, read or change Gmail filters: tell the user plainly and point them to Gmail's settings instead of trying other tool names or the browser.

add_label_ids.description: Label IDs to add to all messages (e.g. ["STARRED", "IMPORTANT"])

message_ids.description: List of message IDs to modify (from gmail_search results)

remove_label_ids.description: Label IDs to remove from all messages (e.g. ["UNREAD", "INBOX"])
